Systematic cell-type resolved transcriptomes of 8 tissues in 8 lab and wild-derived mouse strains capture global and local expression variation

Mapping genomic variation onto cell-type-resolved expression can illuminate complex traits and disease predisposition. Controlled multi-tissue measurements across genetically diverse models are needed to localize effects that bulk or single-strain studies obscure. The IGVF 8-cube profiles 5.2 million nuclei across eight tissues, eight founder strains, and 106 cell types and states, revealing strain divergence concentrated in specific immune and metabolic cell states.
